module: Editor API for manipulating scene objects: selection (by id, reference, type, name mask, screen rectangle), reading/writing fields (static and dynamic, copy/paste), lock/hide, align, translate/rotate/scale the selection, centroid and bounding box, Focus-Lock on a group, prefabs (create, explode, convert to v2, unpack) and SimObject mementos. `initialize` installs everything on `editor` and defines the `editor.SelectMode_*` constants; `initializeFocusLock` adds the Focus-Lock functions. The selection lives in `editor.selection.object` (list of ids). The functions in this file do NOT record undo history: see objectHistoryActions for the `...WithUndo` versions.
notes: Field values are strings (e.g. position "x y z", rotation "0 0 0 0", scale "1 1 1").

Emitted hooks: onEditorObjectSelectionChanged, onEditorFocusLockChanged, onEditorPrefabExploded(groups). The file header lists other hooks (onEditorObjectCreated, ...Delete, ...SelectionLocked/Unlocked/Shown/Hidden/TransformChanged, onEditorPrefabCreated) that are not emitted from this file.
`initialize` is deliberately split from `initializeFocusLock` to stay under Lua's 60-upvalue limit.
Bug: in calculateObjectsCenter and calculateBoundingBoxCenter, `table.insert(stack, childId)` uses an undefined variable (the code reads `childObjId`): subgroups are never traversed.
Probable bug: alignObjectSelectionByBounds starts looking for the reference object at index 2, so the first object is never a candidate.
debugObjectSelection is defined but not exported.

initialize.desc: Remembers the editor, defines editor.SelectMode_* and editor.objectSelectionBBox, and installs the selection, fields, alignment, transform and prefab functions on `editor`.

initializeFocusLock.desc: Separately installs the Focus-Lock functions (getFocusLockedGroup, isFocusLockActive, setFocusLockedGroup, clearFocusLock, isObjectInFocusLockedGroup, resolveAddGroup) to work around initialize's 60-upvalue limit.

editor.desc: Functions added to `editor` by initialize and initializeFocusLock.

matrixToTable.desc: Converts a MatrixF into a serializable table {c0, c1, c2, c3} (columns).

tableToMatrix.desc: Rebuilds a MatrixF from a table {c0, c1, c2, c3}.

canManipulateObject.desc: True if the object exists, is neither a SimSet nor a SimGroup, and is not locked.

getFocusLockedGroup.desc: Returns the group on which Focus-Lock is active (the scene tree shows only it, only its objects are selectable in the view, new objects are created in it). Clears the lock if it points to a deleted group.

isFocusLockActive.desc: True if a valid Focus-Lock is active.

setFocusLockedGroup.desc: Enables Focus-Lock on the group with the given id and emits onEditorFocusLockChanged.

isObjectInFocusLockedGroup.desc: True if no Focus-Lock is active, or if the object is the locked group or one of its descendants.

resolveAddGroup.desc: Returns the Focus-Lock group if it exists, otherwise defaultGroup (group where new objects are added).

isObjectSelectable.desc: True if the object is in the Focus-Lock group and, for a SceneObject, if its selection is enabled.

isObjectSelectionEmpty.desc: True if the object selection is empty.

isObjectSelected.desc: True if the id is part of the object selection.

getSelectionCentroid.desc: Returns the selection center: average of the positions, or the center of the bounding box if the gizmos.general.useObjectBoxCenter preference is true (unless an object has global bounds). vec3(0,0,0) if empty.

computeSelectionBBox.desc: Recomputes editor.objectSelectionBBox and editor.objectSelectionRadius from the selection's world boxes (infinite bounds ignored, falls back to the object box), updates the centroid and, by default, the gizmo (editor.updateObjectSelectionAxisGizmo).

updateGizmo.desc: false to not update the gizmo (default true)

getFieldValue.desc: Reads an object field as a string. Returns "" if the object does not exist.

setObjectSelectedBool.desc: Marks/unmarks each object as selected on the C++ side (setSelected) then rebuilds the shape instance data.

enableEditorOnObjects.desc: Calls onEditorEnable or onEditorDisable on all scene objects that have these methods. Used internally when toggling editor mode; does nothing if the level is not loaded.

validateObjectName.desc: Validates an object name (isValidObjectName); rejects an empty name when newName is true.

newName.desc: true if it is a new name

setFieldValue.desc: Sets a static field of an object (preApply, setField, marks editor-dirty, postApply). Does not go through the history: for undo use editor.changeObjectFieldWithUndo.

arrayIndex.desc: array index (passed through tostring; nil becomes the string "nil")

setDynamicFieldValue.desc: Sets a dynamic field of an object (index 0 by default). For a static field use setFieldValue.

getFieldInfo.desc: Returns the type and flags of a field; empty table if the object does not exist.

getFields.desc: Returns the object's fields intended for the editor (getFieldsForEditor), keyed by name (id, groupName, type, elementCount, fields for arrays...).

getDynamicFields.desc: Returns the list of the object's dynamic field names.

copyFields.desc: Copies an object's field values (excluding the Transform group, name, persistentId, parentGroup), including array elements and dynamic fields.

pasteFields.desc: Applies a copy of copyFields onto an object by id (via setFieldValue/setDynamicFieldValue), reloads the road templates if useTemplate == "true" and marks the level as modified.

pasteFieldsToObject.desc: Like pasteFields but on an already resolved object (calls setField directly, without preApply/postApply).

deleteSelectedObjects.desc: Deletes (editor.deleteObject) all the selected objects and clears the selection. No history: for undo use deleteSelectedObjectsWithUndo.

clearObjectSelection.desc: Deselects everything (on the C++ side too), sets the selection to nil, recomputes the bbox and emits onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.

selectObjects.desc: Modifies the object selection according to the mode, updates the C++ side state, recomputes the bbox and emits onEditorObjectSelectionChanged if it changed. Does not go through the history.

selectObjectsByRef.desc: Like selectObjects but with objects rather than ids.

getObjectsByRectangle.desc: Returns the objects (or forest items if forestData is provided) whose volume intersects a screen rectangle, via a frustum derived from the camera frustum.

objectFlags.desc: type mask (default terrain, water, static shape, player, item, vehicle, light)

selectObjectsByNameMask.desc: Selects the objects whose name contains the Lua pattern (string.find).

selectObjectsByType.desc: Selects the objects whose `className` equals typeName.

selectObjectById.desc: Selects an object by id according to the mode.

deselectObjectSelection.desc: Clears the selection (empty table, on the C++ side too) and emits onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.

lockObjectSelection.desc: Locks the selected objects (locked = "true" field). The original comment ("Select all the objects") is wrong. Not undoable (see lockObjectSelectionWithUndo).

alignObjectSelectionByBounds.desc: Aligns the objects to the extreme bounding box along the axis. boundsAxis values: 0-2 (editor.AxisX/Y/Z) = alignment on the max edge of that axis; 3-5 = min edge of the axis (value - 3). Does nothing (returns true) if there are fewer than 2 objects.

returns.desc: false if boundsAxis is outside 0..5, otherwise true

alignObjectSelectionByCenter.desc: Aligns all manipulable objects to the coordinate of the first selected object for the given axis.

returns.desc: false if the axis is invalid or the first object is not found, otherwise true

setObjectSelectionTransformFromCamera.desc: Places each selected manipulable object at the editor camera's transform while keeping its scale (no undo, TODO in the code).

resetObjectSelectionTransform.desc: Resets rotation to zero and scale to 1,1,1 for the selection.

resetObjectSelectionRotation.desc: Resets the rotation to "0 0 0 0" of the selected manipulable objects.

resetObjectSelectionScale.desc: Resets the scale to "1 1 1" of the selected manipulable objects.

translateObjectSelection.desc: Translates the selected manipulable objects by a delta (via setFieldValue "position").

rotateObjectSelection.desc: Applies the gizmo rotation to the selected objects from the initial state, around centerPoint (positions and orientations). Does nothing without initialTransformations.

initialTransformations.desc: object transforms at the start of the drag

initialGizmoTransform.desc: gizmo transform at the start of the drag

scaleObjectSelection.desc: Scales the selected objects by a delta, around centerPoint (bbox center by default), with bounds 0.01 to 1000 and excluding axes with a zero delta; positions are scaled in the gizmo's frame.

deltaScale.desc: scale delta (does nothing if zero length)

getHighestObject.desc: Returns, among the given ids, the object that is shallowest in the group hierarchy.

calculateObjectsCenter.desc: Computes the center (average of positions) of the children of the given SimGroups. Non-group objects in the list are ignored; subgroups are not traversed (bug: `childId` is an undefined variable, so nothing is pushed). Divides by zero (NaN) if there are no children.

calculateBoundingBoxCenter.desc: Computes the center of the bounding box of the non-group children of the given SimGroups (same limits as calculateObjectsCenter for subgroups).

createPrefabFromObjectSelection.desc: Creates a Prefab from the selection: groups the valid objects into a SimGroup relative to the centroid, registers the Prefab in the group of the topmost object, saves it, deletes the old groups, selects the prefab and marks the level as modified. No undo (TODO).

pathNative.desc: true if the path is native (converted to virtual)

returns.desc: the Prefab, nil if nothing valid

explodeSelectedPrefab.desc: Explodes the selected prefabs into object groups (name <prefab>_unpacked), deletes the prefabs, selects the groups and emits onEditorPrefabExploded(groups).

convertSelectedPrefabsToV2.desc: Converts the selected prefabs to v2 format and replaces them with instances (replaceGroupWithPrefabInstance) at the center of their box.

unpackageSelectedPrefabInstance.desc: Unpackages the selected prefab instances (unpackage) into groups and deletes the instances.

replaceGroupWithPrefabInstance.desc: Spawns an instance of the v2 prefab (spawn, scale 1, zero rotation) at the given position, adds it to the parent group and requests a collision rebuild.

findFirstSelectedByType.desc: Returns the first selected object whose class name is classname.

getObjectSelection.desc: Returns the list of selected ids (empty table if none).

removeInvalidObjects.desc: Returns a copy of the list without the ids that no longer match an existing object.

removeInvalidSelectedObjects.desc: Removes from the selection the ids of objects that no longer exist.

saveSimObjectMemento.desc: Serializes an object to JSON text (memento), "" if nil.

restoreSimObjectMemento.desc: Recreates an object from a memento: removes persistentId, deserializes and gives a unique name (Sim.getUniqueName) derived from the original name.
